text: Si wanaa ndun seytaiiru biftii ndu e majji, jilannde haala, woni konngol e haala Malaa'ika'en, ko tawata fii mun hewtaali yimɓe leydi ɓen; ontuma, ndu jokkintiniree hoodere huɓɓunde, ko sunna ndu. Hino ara ka tawata ndu hewtinii ngol konngol jilaangol, e musidal mayru, haa ngol hewtoya ndaarooɓe ɓen, ado ndu fiɗireede hoodere sunnaynde nden, ɓe ɓeydita ɗon, penaale teemedere.
